summary: Connect the Discord bridge to the daemon default socket instead of an obsolete path.

replay.detail: Align the bridge default with the current daemon XDG socket and its published endpoint link. Explicit socket arguments, bridge storage, routing, payloads and native adapter behavior remain unchanged.
